title: Terminator Hook
description: Hook specification for event-driven automation in the Terminator system

action.description: What type of action to execute

prompt.description: For action=prompt: the prompt text to send to the AI

tool.description: For action=tool_call: the MCP tool to invoke

tool_args.description: For action=tool_call: arguments to pass to the tool

chain.description: For action=chain: the chain ID to execute

channels.description: For on_message_received: which channels to listen on

file_patterns.description: For on_file_change: glob patterns to watch

interval_seconds.description: For on_interval: how often to run (min 60s)

requires_confirmation.description: Whether to ask user before executing

notify_on_complete.description: Send a notification when the hook completes

notify_channel.description: Channel to notify on completion (telegram, discord, slack, email)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this hook does
